notes.title: 🚨 Big Update is here - Police Station! 🚨
notes.content:
[p]The update has arrived! A completely new location has been added to the game - [b]Police Station[/b].
[/p][p]What’s new:

🏢 12 rooms to monitor
👀 215 new anomalies
🔑 10 secret endings
[/p][p]An atmosphere that will make you watch the cameras even more carefully…
[/p][p]This is the biggest [b]Silent Anomalies[/b] update yet, and we can’t wait to hear your impressions 🙌
Share your thoughts in the comments and tell us how many secrets you’ve managed to uncover![/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Update [Version 1.0.3] — Improvements & Fixes!
notes.content:
Hello, Watchers! 🔍👁️

We have released a new update that makes the game even better! Thank you all for your feedback and support. Here’s what has changed:

✨ Improvements:
✅ Increased hitboxes for disappearing objects.
✅ Added a "Game Info" panel — now you’ll have more details about the project.
✅ Added a "Secret Endings" info panel — for those who want to discover all the secrets!

🔧 Fixes:
✅  Fixed a bug with the kitchen door.
✅  Fixed animations.
✅  Pause fix — the game now pauses correctly.
✅  Japanese localization: fixed text spacing for better readability.

🚀 Thank you for playing! If you find anything interesting or have suggestions — let us know in the community! 💙

notes.title: New demo update: more fear and anomalies! 🔥
notes.content:
🎉 [b]We’ve listened to your feedback![/b] 🎉

The demo is now even more exciting and scarier! 😱

We’ve added 5 new anomalies that will surely leave an impression. Among them:
👹 Creepy monsters lurking in the shadows.
💀 Jump scares that will test your nerves.

Are you ready to face new challenges and uncover all the secrets of the house? 🕵️‍♂️

Don’t wait — update the demo now and test your skills! 🔥

🖤 Thank you for playing, and we look forward to your feedback!
